description: Inspect or migrate the organization's concept embedding space. action='status' is read-only; preview, start and cancel require owner. preview estimates cost and reports potential collisions; review them before authorizing start. target_model is required for preview/start; source_model and concept_types scope the move. Starting launches billed background re-embedding while enrichment continues, then switches the selected slices after coverage is complete. Cancel marks the transition cancelled; it does not guarantee interruption or rollback of in-flight work. Returns migration status or preview. See enricher://docs/semantic-ids.

concept_types.description: Restrict the move to these concept types; empty = the whole space.
concept_types.title: Concept Types

source_model.description: Embedding space to move; omitted = the org's current default.
source_model.title: Source Model

target_model.description: Composite key (provider::model) to move to. Required for preview/start.
target_model.title: Target Model

name: migrate_semantic_embeddings
title: Migrate semantic embedding model
